The playbook

From first unit to
running business

The same four steps we run for every Flex unit, with the tools we use at each one

1. Find the right unit

The tools and criteria to judge a unit before you commit to a lease or management deal

  • Check short-let rules first
  • Get the landlord on board
  • Read demand across the year

2. Set it up properly

Licences, insurance, furnishing, smart locks and photos, in the order that avoids expensive rework

  • One record per property
  • Licences and insurance before furniture
  • Photos and listing last

3. Price and fill every night

List on Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, Vrbo and 130+ more channels. Every booking syncs to one calendar, and AI prices each night on real demand

  • All bookings on one calendar
  • AI pricing on real demand
  • Fill gaps with flexible stays

4. Operate on autopilot

One inbox for every guest, automated cleaning schedules and owner reports, run from Base360

  • Every channel in one inbox
  • AI drafts replies, you approve
  • Every checkout becomes a clean
